forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lede: Enter your email and we will send you a link.
forgot.sent: If that address has an account, the link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.lede: You have been invited to {{school}} as {{role}}.
invite.dead: Invitations are valid for seven days and can be used once. Ask your school to send a new one.

change.title: Change your password
change.forced: Choose your own password before you carry on.

band.sessionExpired: That session has expired. Sign in again.
band.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

notFound.title: Nothing here
notFound.body: That address does not exist, or the feature behind it is switched off for this school.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.body: Your account may not open that. Ask your school administrator if you think it should.

home.noClasses: No classes yet — your school adds you to one and it appears here.

user.staleInvite: {{email}} has not accepted their invitation in {{days}} days

profile.title: Your profile
profile.languageHint: Applies straight away, in this browser.
profile.passwordHint: Passwords are at least 10 characters and are never shown.

shell.viewingAs: You are viewing as {{name}} — this view is read-only.

stub.title: Coming soon
stub.phase: This screen arrives in phase {{phase}}. The menu item is here so you know it is coming.
stub.soon: This screen is not built yet.

styleguide.title: Component styleguide
styleguide.subtitle: Every component in every state. Switch language and motion to check both.
styleguide.reduceMotionHint: Collapses every animation to an instant cross-fade.

input.label: School name
input.hint: Parents see this name when they join with a code.

select.label: Curriculum
select.hint: Determines which lessons appear on the map.

checkbox.label: Send an invite email
checkbox.hint: The teacher gets a one-time link valid for seven days.

toggle.label: Complaints
toggle.hint: Turning this off hides Help & complaints in the parent app.

table.label: Lessons
table.empty: No lessons yet — add today's lesson and it appears on every matching map.

card.title: Lessons published
card.body: Cards are the only container: a white panel behind a two-pixel ink rule.

band.error: Could not publish the lesson — the slide deck has no readable text.
band.confirm: Deleting a school removes every class, user and lesson in it.
band.notice: This school is in read-only view-as mode.

phone.label: Parent app preview
phone.caption: Parent mode, 396 × 812
phone.body: The frame scrolls on its own, so a long preview never moves the page.

empty.message: No schools yet — create the first one and invite its managerial user.

motion.body: Every animation goes through one switch. With reduced motion on, each of these becomes an instant cross-fade.

profile.title: Your account lives here
profile.body: Switch between English and Arabic, sign out, or run this tour again from "Show me around".

needsYou.title: What needs you
needsYou.body: Anything waiting on a person appears here, newest first. Each row takes you straight to it.

nav.title: Everything, in one list
nav.body: Schools, users, feature flags, lessons and usage across the whole platform.

switcher.title: One school at a time
switcher.body: Pick a school here and every screen narrows to it. "All schools" puts it back.

cards.title: The three numbers
cards.body: Schools, children and lessons published this week — for the platform, or for the school you picked.

nav.title: Your school only
nav.body: Your lessons, your students, and the questions you send them.

cards.title: How yesterday went
cards.body: Who played, what you published this week, and what is still waiting for your review.

classes.title: Your classes
classes.body: Each card shows whether today's lesson is published. One tap adds the missing one.

nav.title: Your school
nav.body: Complaints from parents, how much the school is using, and your teachers.

cards.title: The three numbers
cards.body: Children, families active this week, and teachers.
